nodes.description: Public uint256 storing aggregated NFT value in USD.
Public uint32 oracle price of the ERC20 token in USD, initialized to 319.
Public uint32 count of NFTs sold, initialized to 94, used as divisor.
Public uint16 target day of month for upkeep check, initialized to 3.
Public uint16 target hour for upkeep check, initialized to 9.
Constant 86400 seconds per day used in date math.
Constant 31536000 seconds per non-leap year.
Constant 31622400 seconds per leap year.
Constant 3600 seconds per hour (declared, unused).
Constant 60 seconds per minute (declared, unused).
Constant 1970 epoch origin year used in timestamp parsing.
Constructor that initializes zNFTValue to 67872.
External setter that overwrites soldNFTCnt with an arbitrary caller value; no access control.
External setter that overwrites the token price oracle value; no access control.
External setter that overwrites the upkeep target day; no access control.
External setter that overwrites the upkeep target hour; no access control.
Keeper view function that parses block.timestamp and compares day/hour against state to decide upkeepNeeded.
Keeper function recomputing zNFTValue = 20000*price/soldNFTCnt; division can revert and result is manipulable.
Pure helper returning whether a given year is a leap year.
Pure helper counting leap years before a given year.
Pure helper returning the number of days in a month for a year.
Internal pure function decomposing a timestamp into a _DateTime struct.
Pure helper deriving the year from a timestamp with a correction loop.
Pure helper returning month from timestamp via parseTimestamp.
Pure helper returning day from timestamp via parseTimestamp.
Pure helper returning hour of day from timestamp.
Pure helper returning minute from timestamp.
Pure helper returning second from timestamp.
Pure helper returning weekday index from timestamp.
Miner/validator-influenced timestamp used as datetime source in checkUpkeep.
Price, count and schedule state can be rewritten by any external account, enabling manipulation of keeper outcomes.
Division by user-controllable soldNFTCnt in performUpkeep; zero divisor reverts and small divisor inflates zNFTValue.
Upkeep trigger depends on block.timestamp, allowing miner manipulation of the 9am/3rd-day condition.
Parameter cnt of setSoldNFTCnt written directly into soldNFTCnt.
Parameter price of setCPERC20TokenPriceUSD written directly into the price state.
Parameter _day of setDateDay written directly into dateDay.
Parameter _hour of setDateHour written directly into dateHour.
Calldata parameter checkData of checkUpkeep, echoed back as performData.
Calldata parameter performData of performUpkeep, unused in computation.
Parameter timestamp threaded through parseTimestamp/getYear/getHour helpers.

edges.reason: Constructor writes the initial zNFTValue state.
setSoldNFTCnt writes caller value into soldNFTCnt.
setCPERC20TokenPriceUSD writes caller value into the price state.
setDateDay writes caller value into dateDay.
setDateHour writes caller value into dateHour.
Public setter mutates critical state without owner or role check.
Public price setter allows arbitrary oracle value overwrite.
Public schedule setter allows arbitrary upkeep target day.
Public schedule setter allows arbitrary upkeep target hour.
Parameter cnt flows into soldNFTCnt assignment.
Parameter price flows into price state assignment.
Parameter _day flows into dateDay assignment.
Parameter _hour flows into dateHour assignment.
block.timestamp feeds the upkeep decision, making it miner-dependent.
Timestamp dependency is the unsafe condition for keeper triggering.
checkUpkeep reads dateDay for the equality test.
checkUpkeep reads dateHour for the equality test.
checkUpkeep calls parseTimestamp on block.timestamp.
checkData parameter is returned as performData.
Calldata checkData enters checkUpkeep scope.
performUpkeep reads manipulable cpERC20TokenPriceUSD for valuation.
performUpkeep divides by manipulable soldNFTCnt.
Price state flows into the zNFTValue computation.
soldNFTCnt flows into the zNFTValue computation as divisor.
Unchecked user-controlled divisor can revert or inflate the result.
performUpkeep overwrites zNFTValue with the new computed value.
performData calldata is accepted but ignored by performUpkeep.
parseTimestamp calls getYear to derive the year.
parseTimestamp calls getDaysInMonth for month/day loops.
parseTimestamp calls leapYearsBefore for year seconds accounting.
parseTimestamp calls getHour.
parseTimestamp calls getMinute.
parseTimestamp calls getSecond.
parseTimestamp calls getWeekday.
getDaysInMonth calls isLeapYear for February length.
getYear calls leapYearsBefore to count leap years.
getYear calls isLeapYear in the correction loop.
getMonth delegates to parseTimestamp.
getDay delegates to parseTimestamp.
leapYearsBefore compares against ORIGIN_YEAR.
parseTimestamp uses ORIGIN_YEAR in seconds accounting.
parseTimestamp uses DAY_IN_SECONDS for month/day increments.
parseTimestamp uses YEAR_IN_SECONDS for non-leap seconds.
parseTimestamp uses LEAP_YEAR_IN_SECONDS for leap seconds.
getYear uses YEAR_IN_SECONDS in its arithmetic.
getYear uses LEAP_YEAR_IN_SECONDS in its arithmetic.
getWeekday divides timestamp by DAY_IN_SECONDS.
timestamp parameter is the input consumed by parseTimestamp.
timestamp parameter drives getHour arithmetic.
timestamp parameter drives getMinute arithmetic.
timestamp parameter drives getSecond arithmetic.
timestamp parameter drives getWeekday arithmetic.

normalization_plan.reason: cnt is only a forwarding parameter of setSoldNFTCnt and carries no independent semantics.
price is only a forwarding parameter of setCPERC20TokenPriceUSD.
_day is only a forwarding parameter of setDateDay.
_hour is only a forwarding parameter of setDateHour.
checkData is the calldata input of checkUpkeep and is returned verbatim.
performData is an unused calldata input of performUpkeep.
timestamp is the shared input parameter threaded through the datetime helpers, rooted at parseTimestamp.
